The company was founded in 1946 and is headquartered in Mito, Japan.

Nippn Corporation engages in flour milling and food business in Japan and internationally. It offers premixes, corn products, rice flour, wheat flour and bran, olive oil, flax seed products, etc.; dried noodles; bread, noodles, and confectionery; frozen ingredients and food; and ready-made meals. The company also provides premixes, which include tempura flour, okonomiyaki flour, pancake mixes, etc., under the REGALO brand; and frozen pasta and pasta sauce, cooked rice, popular dishes, snacks, desserts, frozen dough, etc. In addition, it is involved in the research and development of machinery and equipment, healthcare, pet care, pet food, biotechnology, engineering, warehousing, port transportation, and other business. The company was formerly known as Nippon Flour Mills Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Nippn Corporation in January 2021. Nippn Corporation was founded in 1896 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

Nisshin Seifun Group Inc., through its subsidiaries, engages in the flour milling, processed foods, prepared dishes and other prepared foods, and other businesses in Japan and internationally. The company manufactures and sells wheat-related products, including bran, wheat germ, rye flour, and other food-related items; home-use and commercial-use premixes, pastas, and pasta sauces marketed under the Nisshin, Ma?Ma, Ao-no-Dokutsu, De Cecco, and Welna brands; bakery fillings, cooking fillings, and mayonnaise for use in the bakery industry and other areas; and biotechnology business. It also provides health foods and functional food product materials; and delicatessen products, frozen products, as well as soba, udon, Chinese noodles, and fresh pasta to convenience stores through home delivery service. In addition, the company offers engineering services for plants producing various food items; and engages in mesh cloth business. Nisshin Seifun Group Inc. was founded in 1900 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Nitto Fuji Flour Milling Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells flour products in Japan. The company offers wheat, bread, noodle, pasta, bran, mixed, alps, whole meal, and rye flour; and powders, hotcake high mix, and commercial frozen dough. It is also involved in warehousing business for storing wheat, and Kentucky Fried Chickens; and restaurant business. In addition, the company operates KFC franchisee in the Kanto and Tokai regions. The company was incorporated in 1914 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Nitto Fuji Flour Milling Co.,Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Mitsubishi Corporation.

business_summary: Chubu Shiryo Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells compound feed for livestock and fisheries in Japan. It operates through two segments, Feed and Other. The company offers animal feed, including poultry, pig, cattle, and fish feed; livestock and fishery products, such as sesame eggs, sweet potato pork, chicken, and Ebisu yellowtail to supermarkets and retailers; is involved in meat business; organic compound fertilizers; and livestock equipment. It also provides livestock medical services, such as livestock hygiene management, pathological testing, and instruction on breeding techniques, as well as livestock insurance. The company was incorporated in 1949 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

Logos Holdings Inc. operates as a home builder in Japan. It designs, constructs, and sells houses. The company is also involved in the intermediation and brokerage, and purchase and sale of land, as well as renovation services. In addition, it engages in the digital transformation support business; and provides residential offshore CAD services. The company was incorporated in 2020 and is headquartered in Sapporo, Japan.

Feed One Co.,Ltd. procures, produces, processes, markets, and sells meat, egg, seafood, and compound feed in Japan and internationally. It offers Poultry feed comprising layers, breeders, broilers, and quail in the form of mashes, crumbles, crumbles and mashes, etc.; pig feed, including nursery diets, grow-finish diets, and sow diets in the form of granule, mash, pellets, crumbles, etc.; and cattle feed, such as milk replacer, starter, for heifers, dairy cattle rearing, beef cattle grower, beef cattle fattening, and breeding of wagyu in the form of granules, pellets, mashes, flakes and pellets, and flake and mash, as well as flakes, pellet, and roughage. The company also provides fishery feeds, including mash feed, granules, crumbles, and dry and extruded pellets; and livestock technical services, as well as produces and sells aquatic feed. In addition, it offers beekeeping feed. Further, the company engages in other ancillary businesses, farm-management consulting, management of veterinary examination and treatment facilities, etc. The company was formerly known as Feed One Holdings Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Feed One Co.,Ltd. in October 2015. Feed One Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2014 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.

PRISM BioLab Co.,LTD engages in the research and development of pharmaceuticals using its proprietary drug discovery platform technology, PepMetics Technology. It develops E7386 targeting CBP/beta-catenin, which is in Phase II clinical trial for the treatment of cancer; and PRI724 targeting CBP/beta-catenin that is in Phase II clinical trial for treating cirrhosis. The company has a strategic collaboration with Receptor.AI Inc. for the development of an AI-integrated drug discovery platform. The company was founded in 2006 and is based in Fujisawa, treating Japan.

KOZO KEIKAKU ENGINEERING HOLDINGS Inc., a professional design and engineering company, provides solutions in the fields of safety and security, information transmission, manufacturing, and scientific decision-making support in Japan. The company provides structural design and structural analysis consulting services for high-rise and large buildings; environment assessment and disaster risk reduction consulting services related to ground motion assessment, wind condition analysis, and disaster risk assessment; and IT system development for housing and construction comprising system development including CAD, BIM, and structural calculation. It also offers decision-making support consulting services; and information and communication technology consulting services, such as communication network, radio wave propagation, and electromagnetic field simulation. In addition, the company provides manufacturing industry related services, including CAE, thermal flow analysis, particle-based simulation, granular simulation, sales support solutions, etc.; architectural building analysis, ground analysis, etc.; radio propagation analysis, etc.; social simulation, risk assessment, statistical analysis, optimization, human flow measurement, etc.; e-mail delivery services; cloud-based entry/exit control platform, etc.; and cloud services. The company was founded in 1956 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Nippon Beet Sugar Manufacturing Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells functional products in Japan. The company offers beet and refined sugar; beet molasses; baker's yeast; and oligosaccharides and others; compound and functional feed for dairy and beef cattle, as well as feed component analysis and design, and farming support. It also manufactures and sells paper pot, soil packing and seeding tools, and transplanting equipment under the Chain Pot and Hippari-kun names. In addition, the company is involved in the leasing of office buildings, commercial spaces, and other properties; and research and development activities under food, agricultural equipment and materials, sugar beets, and livestock areas. Nippon Beet Sugar Manufacturing Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1919 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Mitsui DM Sugar Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells refined sugar and functional food materials in Japan. It operates through the Sugar Business, Life Energy Business, and Real Estate Business segments. The Sugar Business manufactures and sells raw sugar, processed sugar, and sugar-related products; rock sugar, liquid sugar, brown crystal sugar, sugar stick sachets, powdered sugar, gum syrup, and soft drink concentrates; centrifugal sugar and black sugar; sweeteners and other food ingredients; and functional food. This segment also engages in the manufacture, sale, and cargo handling of product packaging materials. The Life Energy segment provides food colorings, flavorings, sugar cane extract, agar, food additives, bio-based products, nutritional care supplements, and nutritional products for patients with dysphagia, as well as life support, and home delivery lunch box services. The Real Estate Business segment is involved in the leasing of land, retail premises, and offices, as well as warehouse operations. The company was formerly known as Mitsui DM Sugar Holdings Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Mitsui DM Sugar Co.,Ltd. in April 2025. Mitsui DM Sugar Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Ensuiko Sugar Refining Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells sugar products in Japan. The company offers refined, granular, white, brown, and liquid sugar, as well as other sweeteners; lactose fructose oligosaccharide; sugarcane oligo; red beet; cyclodextrin; and Salacia. Ensuiko Sugar Refining Co., Ltd. was founded in 1904 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Fuji Nihon Corporation engages in the manufacture and sale of refined sugar and sugar-related products in Japan. It offers refined white, granulated, brown and medium brown, rock, and liquid and liquid brown sugar. The company also provides inulin, a water-soluble fiber found in vegetables for maintaining the intestine clean; and cut flower nutrients under the KEEPFLOWER brand name, as well as offers consultancy services for growers, florists, and customers. In addition, it offers food additives preparations and functional materials. The company was formerly known as Fuji Nihon Seito Corporation and changed its name to Fuji Nihon Corporation in October 2024. Fuji Nihon Corporation was incorporated in 1949 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

WELLNEO SUGAR Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells sugar and other food products primarily in Japan. It operates in Sugar Business and Food & Wellness segments. The Sugar business segment offers sugar under the Cup, Kururu, and SEVEN brand names. The Food & Wellness segment provides functional food materials, food additives, edible films, pharmaceutical and cosmetic materials, and sugar-derived sweetener products, as well as operates gym. It also operates a refrigerated warehouse and warehousing business for storage, cargo handling, and harbor transportation services. The company was formerly known as Nissin Sugar Co., Ltd. WELLNEO SUGAR Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2011 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Cados Corporation operates as a construction company in Japan. The company undertakes architectural construction and civil engineering work. It is also involved in planning, designing, and consulting of architectural and civil engineering activities; and real estate buying and selling, leasing, brokerage, and management. The company was founded in 1998 and is based in Yamaguchi, Japan.

LIFULL Co.,Ltd. provides real estate information services in Japan and internationally. It offers LIFULL HOME'S, a site of real estate and housing information; LIFULL Revitalize Rural Japan that suggests new lifestyles to people in Japan based on the refurbishment of abandoned houses; LIFULL Move, which provides rankings and reviews of moving companies; LIFULL Nursing Care, a website related to nursing homes or other serviced housing for seniors; and LIFULL Investment, a money lending website. The company also provides LIFULL FaM that enables working mothers to balance childcare with work while pursuing a career; LIFULL Storage, a storage space searching web service; LIFULL HUB, a coworking space in an office; LIFULL Fab for design and craftsmanship; and LIFULL Table, a gallery and open space for photography, exhibitions, press releases, and workshops. In addition, it offers LivingAnywhere Commons, a network of accommodations with co-working spaces; instant house products; LIFULL FaM Partners, which offer back-office support services; LIFULL Agri Loop, an antioxidant technology; LIFULL ALT-RHYTHM, a team in the Japanese professional dance league; and leadership development programs. LIFULL Co.,Ltd. was formerly known as NEXT Co., Ltd. and changed its name to LIFULL Co.,Ltd. in April 2017. The company was founded in 1995 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Interspace Co.,Ltd. engages in the provision of internet advertising and media services in Japan, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam, Singapore, and Malaysia. The company offers ACCESSTRADE, an affiliate platform; MobileWindow, a digital transformation solution service for store operators; SiteLead, a SaaS that uses heatmap analysis and popup functions to improve websites; and FANIPRO, an advertising matching platform for influencers. It also provides mamastadium, an information website for moms; Yoga Journal Online, a yoga and beauty online news media for yoga news and lifestyle; Juku-Sil, a cram school search site; 4MEEE, a lifestyle media outlet; and 4yuuu, a lifestyle media outlet for moms; 4MOON, a health record app is for all women; Job Change Dispatch Search, a comprehensive job change and dispatch media; Prolia, provide content that supports your decision-making by incorporating reliable reviews; Prolia Programming, a review site that delivers real reviews of programming schools; and Proria English Conversation, a media for English learners. The company was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

FIT EASY Inc. engages in planning, operation, and franchise development of fitness clubs in Japan. Its amusement facilities include saunas, golf, self-esthetics, o2 room, aero, baseball, laundry, fit-whitening, pilates, race, ride, tennis, futsul, tanning, and bouldering services. FIT EASY Inc. was incorporated in 2018 and is based in Gifu, Japan.

Members Co., Ltd. engages in the DX support services in Japan. It offers production/UI/UX, marketing DX, digital service development, data utilization support, SaaS utilization, project management, and decarbonization DX and circular economy services. Members Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Kitahama Capital Partners Co.,Ltd., formerly known as Sun Capital Management Corp., is private equity and venture capital firm specializing in venture, turnaround, and M&A investments. It focuses on investments in the renewable energy, inbound tourism, regional revitalization, technology, and emerging needs sectors, as well as businesses utilizing financial technology. It prefers to invests in companies that develops, manufactures and sales ships, automobiles, fuel reduction equipment for boilers, and exhaust gas suppression devices. The firm prefers to invest in companies located in Kansai and western Japan. It is also involve in asset management consignment services, financial advisory services, brokerage services, financial advisories and consulting services. Kitahama Capital Partners Co.,Ltd. was founded on September 1992 and is based in Osaka, Japan, with an additional offices in Tokyo, Japan.

CROOZ, Inc. provides IT outsourcing and E-commerce services. It operates through IT Outsourcing Business and EC Business segments. It engages in system engineering services business and other human resources development services. The company also offers mail order services via the Internet, including select shop operations for original and top-brand products. It serves corporate clients requiring IT solutions and operates in global markets. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Chuco Co., Ltd. engages in the magazine business in Japan. It is involved in the publication and operation of the magazine Happy Media, Regional Mitchaku Lifestyle information magazine, and Sumimoichi; sales promotion, such as advertising agency; sales promotion planning and operation; general advertising agency business, mail order business; and event and seminar business. It also operates Frimo, a coupon app. The company was incorporated in 1978 and is headquartered in Gifu, Japan.

ITmedia Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the internet media business in Japan. It operates through B to B Media Business and B to C Media Business segments. The company offers lead/prospective customer generation services comprising pipeline dashboards, ABM reports and alerts, and trade show promotions; advertorial article; email magazine advertisement; banner ads; B2B research; webcast; registration drive for in-house webinars; and sponsorship opportunities for events. It serves the IT industry, business, and consumer markets, as well as the electronics, mechanics, and manufacturing industries. The company was formerly known as Softbank ITmedia, Inc. and changed its name to ITmedia Inc. in March 2005. ITmedia Inc. was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan. ITmedia Inc. is a subsidiary of SB Media Holdings Corp.

E J Holdings Inc., through its subsidiaries, engages in the civil engineering consultant business in Japan and internationally. It offers environment, disaster prevention/maintenance, and government support services; research and development; and survey services. The company was incorporated in 2007 and is based in Okayama, Japan.

FRONTEO, Inc. provides artificial intelligence (AI) solutions and services in Japan and internationally. The company operates through Life science AI Business, Risk Management Business, and DX business segment. It offers e-discovery support and forensic investigation services; KIBIT, a digital forensic software; and forensic tools. The company also offers business intelligence AI products, such as Communication Meter, an email and chat audit system; WordSonar for AccidentView, a system that predicts the disaster risk of construction site; WordSonar for VoiceView, a solution use for customer voices; Knowledge Probe, a business data analysis support system; Patent Explorer, a patent search support system; Q&A system that learns the characteristics of questions and presents the answers; Kibi+-Connect, an API for the artificial intelligence engine; and AI training and support services. In addition, it provides Concept Encoder, an AI algorithm specialized for the healthcare industry; Looca Cross, an AI engine; and economic security AI solutions. The company was formerly known as UBIC, Inc. and changed its name to FRONTEO, Inc. in July 2016. The company was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

GNI Group Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sale of pharmaceuticals and biomaterials in Japan, China, and the United States. It operates in two segments, Pharmaceutical Business and Medical Equipment Business. The company offers ETUARY for the treatment of idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis; H-GENIN Crush-Mix for the treatment of bone defects; AltiPly for the treatment of acute and chronic wounds; and orthobiologics products. It also develops ETUARY which is in Phase III clinical trial for the treatment of pneumoconiosis, dermatomyositis interstitial lung disease, and systemic sclerosis-associated interstitial lung disease; and F351 which is in Phase III clinical trial for the treatment of chronic hepatitis B liver fibrosis. In addition, the company is involved in the development of ETUARY which is in Phase II clinical trial for the treatment of radiation-induced lung injury with or without immune-related pneumonitis; F573 which is in Phase II clinical trial for the treatment of acute liver failure and acute-on-chronic liver failure; F351 which is in Phase I clinical trial for the treatment of MASH-advanced liver fibrosis; and F230 which is in Phase I clinical trial for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension. Further, it develops CG001419 which is in Phase Ia clinical trial for the treatment of acute and chronic pain; CG001419 which is in Phase Ia clinical trial for the treatment of solid tumors; and CG009301 which is in Phase Ia clinical trial for the treatment of leukemia and MYC+ cancers. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Chiikishinbunsha Co.,Ltd. engages in publishing of newspapers in Japan. The company is also involved in insert flyers distribution; and sales promotion support businesses. In addition, the company is involved in web and culture business; and provides exterior wall painting contracting, Job advertisement, web advertisement, and promotional support services. Chiikishinbunsha Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Yachiyo, Japan.

CDS Co.,Ltd. engages in the technical information solutions business in Japan. The company offers technical information solutions, including instruction and service manuals, digital and web/e-learning content, multilingual translation, one-source/multiple uses, consulting, and 3D-CAD design. It also provides robot solutions, including manufacturing services using robot automation systems; human resource development using industrial education and vocational training materials; and digital transformation human resource and education center services. In addition, the company offers digital solutions, including planning, development, construction, operation, and education for various systems; design, construction, and operation of IT infrastructure; system integration; system product sales; and contract control design for vehicles, aerospace, industrial machinery mechatronics, distribution and logistics, energy, and education sectors. The company was incorporated in 1980 and is headquartered in Okazaki, Japan.

Link and Motivation Inc. provides consulting and cloud services in Japan. The company operates through Development Division, Individual Development Division, and Matching Division segments. The company offers human capital management; motivation cloud, an HRTech (Human Resources x Technology) solution that helps resolve issues; and HR transformation services, including diagnostics and solutions covering all areas of recruitment, and training, and organizational. It also provides mid-career employee training, management training, training for young people, human resources recruitment services. In addition, the company offers ALT placement that support for matching individuals from overseas seeking to work in Japan with local governments and openwork, a recruiting platform, as well as IR support services, including support for helping companies improve investor engagement. Further, it operates career school programs to support career advancement by providing courses for obtaining qualifications, as well as courses for elementary, junior high, and high school students; cram school to support for improving the academic skills of elementary, junior high, and high school students; and venture incubation services. Link and Motivation Inc. was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Hakuten Corporation engages in the experience marketing business in Japan. It integrates and designs human experiences, such as event promotion, business meetings and private shows, seminars and conferences, exhibition participation, stores and showrooms, and online events and seminars, as well as communication design, digital content and marketing, and support for urban development and cultural development solutions. The company was founded in 1967 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

SMS Co., Ltd. provides information infrastructure for the nursing care, medical care, career, healthcare, and elderly care field business areas in Japan and internationally. The company provides career services such as Web community for nurses/nursing students, Job information for nursing students, recruiting agent service(RAG) for nurses, midwives, radiological and medical technologists, clinical engineers, public health nurses, registered dietitians, care workers, PT/OT/ST, childcare workers, therapists, care managers, social workers, and disability care workers; workplace assessment tool for nurses; school for workers in the elderly care field; information service on qualification courses for elderly care; media platform; cross-occupational direct recruiting; scholarship information for high school students/nursing students; and web community for registered dietitians. It also offers elderly/disability care services such as management support for elderly/disability care operators, information portal for the management of home-visit nursing care operators and elderly care operators, research and information on the aging society, and business support for disability care operators; and healthcare services offers remote specific and industrial health services, remote preventive solution for lifestyle-related diseases, RAG for persons with disabilities, information portal of industrial health service, stress checks specialized for medical care and elderly care industries, and solution for balancing work with family care. In addition, the company offers senior life services such as web community for people struggling with elderly care and care managers, referral service of renovation operators, housing for the elderly, home-delivered meals, funeral companies; RAG for construction and real estate industry; and medical information for healthcare professionals. SMS Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Linical Co., Ltd., a global contract research organization, provides full spectrum of drug development services to pharmaceutical companies worldwide. The company offers drug discovery consulting services, such as market analysis and research of products in development, regulatory affairs, and licensing support. It also provides clinical trial evaluation, statistical analysis, medical writing, pharmacovigilance, clinical monitoring, and contract medical affairs services. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Sobal Corporation engages in the development of embedded software for digital appliances in Japan. The company researches and develops wireless communication technologies; offers various engineering services, including worker dispatching, trustee business, and contract work; technical skills; and manual production services. It also provides firmware and device drivers for digital cameras, video and signage, televisions, liquid-crystal projectors, various recorders, switchers, digital complex machines, laser and ink-jet printers, sublimation and label printers, scanners, handy terminals, and embedded browsers. In addition, the company offers application software, such as video editing and delivery, poster creation supporting, document and print management, and car navigation software, as well as graphic library and various simulators; and Web application services for answering machines, portal sites, medical information transmission systems, and various internal systems, as well as employment support for schools. Further, the company provides hardware products, which include image filter, display, and analysis circuits, as well as various arithmetic circuits. Sobal Corporation was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Liberaware Co., Ltd. engage in the development, processing and analysis technologies provide small drones specialized for industrial fields system using IoT technology and artificial intelligence. The company offer sale, and rental of non-GPS; inspection and installation, automatic patrol, digital transformation, and contract development services. In addition, it provides video processing and editing services. Liberaware Co., Ltd. was founded in 2016 and is based in Chiba, Japan.

Cookpad Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the cooking business in Japan. The company offers Cookpad, a recipe posting and search service; Cookpad Mart, an online marketplace for fresh produce; moment, an AI camera that analyzes cooking and provides specific advice; and other related services. It also provides Cookpad News, an online cooking magazine; and Tabemiru, an analytical tool that accumulates recipe search data. The company was formerly known as Coin Ltd. and changed its name to Cookpad Inc. in June 1999. Cookpad Inc. was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Meguro, Japan.

Amita Holdings Co.,Ltd. develops and provides social design services in Japan and internationally. The company offers Cyano Project, a transition support services for sustainable management which includes carbon neutral, circular economy, and nature positivity promotion support. It also provides Co-Creation City, a sustainable urban development service; and environmental certification audit services based on third-party certification systems. In addition, the company supplies alternative resources to cement manufacturers as alternative raw materials and fuels for cement; and imports and export of alternative resources. The company was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Kyoto, Japan.

IKK Holdings Inc. engages in the wedding businesses in Japan. The company operates through Wedding, Nursing Care, Food, and Photo business. The company is involved in operation of paid nursing homes and provision of nursing care services; provision of services, such as planning and management for wedding ceremonies, and receptions; planning, development, and sales of wedding favors, sweets, and other gift items; and providing services, comprising planning and operation of photo weddings, and photo studios. The company was formerly known as IKK Inc. and changed its name to IKK Holdings Inc. in May 2021. IKK Holdings Inc. was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Imari, Japan.

Heartseed Inc. develops and commercializes iPS cell-derived cardiomyocyte replacement therapy for heart failure. The company's lead product is HS-001 for heart failure with reduced ejection fraction indications, including dilated cardiomyopathy, old myocardial infraction, and dilated phase of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy. It also develops products using autologous iPSC and HLA knock-out iPSC. In addition, the company offers differentiation induction, mass culture, purification, and myocardial globule production technology. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Ezaki Glico Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, produces and sells confectionery, health and food, dairy products, and food ingredients in Japan, China, Southeast Asia, the United States, and internationally. It operates through six segments: Health and Food Business; Dairy Business; Nutritional Confectionery Business; Food Ingredients Business; Other Domestic Business; and Overseas Business. The company produces and sells health-related products, retort food, ice cream, milk, dairy products, western confectioneries, chocolate, biscuits, wheat protein, modified starch, coloring, fine chemical materials and others. It also provides baby formula and processed foods. It sells its products in offices and stores, as well as through e-commerce. Ezaki Glico Co., Ltd. was founded in 1922 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Meito Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of confectionery, beverages, seasoned foods, food additives, and other food products in Japan and internationally. It provides chocolates, such as alphabet, nut, best assortment, strawberry, adult-oriented liquor, crunchy dome, creamy, cookie crunch, peanut, donut, and acorn picnic chocolates; and premix such as lemon, apple, peach, royal milk, stickmate rooibos and jasmine, warm ginger, and melting fruit tea; lemonade, masala chai, stickmate assortment, aquamate, milk cocoa, and jelly. The company also offers candies, which includes soda mix, fruit drops, butter salt, crushed slated lemon, mineral salt candy; vitamin C, herb mint ice creams, milk, ginger, and manuka honey throat lozenges; chocolate balls, café au lait, chocolate-flavored shine muscat grapes, chocolate banana, melon soda, black sugar kinako stick, berele vanilla and strawberry multi, white berele, strawberry ice bar, grappestro and soda, and grape cafe au lait and melon; coffee, pudding and vanilla ice cream; chewy and bouncy fruit bar white peach, grape, and pineapple; and strawberry, uji kintoki, and coffee float. In addition, it provides nutritious food products, such as watermate apple and grape, hot mate honey lemon, kudzu jelly mix with iron and zinc, black sugar flavor, delicious and healthy throat lozenges blueberry flavor and lemon herb, delicious and healthy chocolate and strawberry flavor, delicious and healthy cocoa and café au lait. Further, the company manufactures and sells pharmaceuticals, quasi-drugs, medical devices, veterinary drugs, cosmetics, and other chemical products. Further, the company constructs and manages public golf courses; and rents real estate properties. The company was formerly known as Meito Sangyo Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Meito Co., Ltd. in September 2025. Meito Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1945 and is headquartered in Nagoya, Japan.

Bourbon Corporation manufactures and sells confectionery, beverages, food, frozen desserts, and other products in Japan. The company offers cookies, wheat flour crackers, bean snacks, candies, deserts, rice biscuits, snacks, delicacies, chocolates, chewing gums, mineral water, coffee, cocoa beverages, and other soft drinks; and powdered cocoa, liquor, rice, bread, and instant ramen, as well as gifts. It markets its products through vending machines and mail orders. The company was formerly known as Kitanihon Shokuhin Kogyo Corporation and changed its name to Bourbon Corporation in June 1989. Bourbon Corporation was incorporated in 1924 and is based in Kashiwazaki, Japan.

Imuraya Group Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of various food products in Japan and internationally. It offers confectionary, including bean jellies, and pancakes; processed food, such as bean paste, sweet porridge, shaved ice syrup, and sticky steamed rice; steamed bun with meat fillings and sweetened bean fillings; ice creams; tofu and refrigerated products; frozen sweets; and powdered seasoning products. The company also operates an American style restaurant under the Anna Miller's name; and South France Provence Patisserie under the La maison JOUVAUD name. In addition, the company is involved in managing leasing agency; real-estate leasing; and provision of property management. The company was formerly known as Imuraya Confectionery Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Imuraya Group Co., Ltd. in October 2010. The company was founded in 1896 and is based in Tsu, Japan.

Faber Company Inc. provides digital marketing automation tool solution in Japan. It offers Mielca SEO, a digital marketing automation solutions; and Mielca Heat Map that tracks the behavior of the site visitor on the website, as well as visualizes and analyzes the behavior data on the website; Local Mielca, an automated local marketing solution; Mielca Connect, which provides freelance or sideline digital marketing talents; and Douga Mielka, an analysis and video marketing support tool. The company also provides Conversion Mielca, a tool that analyzes information about users who visit a website and offers them with content appropriate to that user; Dekiruka, an e-learning solution for digital talent development and reskilling; SEO ZERO, a SEO tool for smartphones; and WARP, a screen recording and video capturing solution. In addition, it operates a YouTube channel under the Mielca Channel name; media for web marketers under the Mielca Marketing Journal name; and digital marketing media for writing articles under the Web Manager Forum name. The company was incorporated in 2005 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Fujiya Co., Ltd. engages in the production and wholesale of confectionery, food, and ice cream products in Japan and China. The company offers shortcake, chocolate cake, peko-chan's cheeks, and whole cake; and candies, chocolates, cookies, and other sweet products under the Milky, Look, Country Maam, Chocolate Covered, and Home Pie names; canned, PET bottled, and chilled beverages under the Nectar and Lemon Squash names. It also operates restaurant under the Fujiya Restaurant, Anpanman Restaurant, Anpanman & Peko's Kitchen names; Ginza Miyachiku, a teppanyaki restaurant specializing in Miyazaki beef; and Fujiya online store under the Family Town name. In addition, the company engages in the provision of outsourcing services; and real estate and building management and insurance agency businesses. The company was founded in 1910 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Fujiya Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Yamazaki Baking Co., Ltd.

Yamazaki Baking Co., Ltd. engages in the food business in Japan. The company operates through Food Business, Distribution Business, and Other Business segments. The company offers loaf bread, sweet buns, donuts, hard rolls, and pastries; skewered rice dumplings, sweet bean filled rice cakes, pancake style sweets, steamed cakes, castella, and yokan; swiss rolls, cream puffs, snack cakes and pound cakes; and processed bread and noodles, and prepared rice. It also provides strawberry and blueberry jams, marmalade, jelly and sweet bean, ready-to-eat curry in retort pouches, and other kinds of preserves; biscuits, cookies, chocolates, and rice-derived confectionery; and coffee and juice under the Yamazaki brand, as well as fillings of various confectionary products; and cream, curry fillings, stuffing for Chinese filled buns, croquettes, meat patty, and mayonnaise. In addition, the company is involved in logistics business; designing equipment for food manufacturing; supervision; construction contracting; office work; non-life insurance agency; cleaning of food manufacturing machinery; manufacturing and sale of cleaning agents; operation of instore baking and the convenience store business. The company was incorporated in 1948 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

First Baking Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells food products in Japan. The company offers various bread and rolls, Japanese and western sweets, cookies, apple ring, large danish, anpan, pokemon bread, and precure bread, etc. It also leases land and buildings. The company was incorporated in 1947 and is headquartered in Kodaira, Japan.

Kanro Inc. manufactures and sells confectionery and food products in Japan. The company offers candies, gummies, and confectionery ingredients. It also engages in digital commerce and design business. The company provides its products under the Kanro Ame, Kin no Milk, Kenko Nodoame, Sugar-Free, Puré Gummy, and Candemina brand names. It also manages stores under the HITOTUBU KANRO name. Kanro Inc. was founded in 1912 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Kameda Seika Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells rice crackers and snacks in Japan and internationally. Scinex Corporation engages in the information media, DX support, logistics, and healthcare businesses in Japan and internationally. The company publishes My Town Encyclopedia, a regional government information magazine that connects local governments, residents, and businesses; and Telepal 50, an alphabetical telephone directory. It also offers My Town NAVI, a digital signage for government offices and large commercial facilities; My Town Portal, a city promotion site; My Town AI Chatbot, which utilizes artificial intelligence to support public services and business; e-commerce site for supporting local specialties and hometown tax donations; and Shiireru, a marketplace service that connects local businesses with e-commerce retailers. In addition, the company provides ICT business, system engineering, and system integration solutions; and My Town Pay, a digital platform app that allows to use digital tickets, as well as plans, develops, and produces digital contents. Further, the company offers logistics services to support local governments and businesses; dental services, materials, and medical equipment; and investment services. Scinex Corporation was founded in 1953 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.

Renaissance,Incorporated engages in sports club business in Japan. It operates fitness clubs, swimming schools, tennis schools, golf schools, and other sports clubs. The company also provides health promotional services for local municipalities; nursing care and rehabilitation support services; and store development support services. In addition, it develops and promotes Synapsology, a brain activation method. The company was founded in 1979 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

DIP Corporation engages in the human resources service business in Japan. The company offers dip AI, a dialogue-based part-time job search service; Baitoru talk, a communication app for store managers and part-time employees; Baitoru, a portal website for part time employees; Spot Baitoru, a job matching service that connects people who want to work in their spare time with establishments looking for workers; Baitoru NEXT, a job information website for those who are looking to work as regular or contract employees; Baitoru PRO, a job information site for specialized jobs; Hatarako net, a portal website connecting companies with those seeking regular, dispatched or part-time employment; Nurse de Hatarako, a job agency website for nurses; and Kaigo de Hatarako, a job agency website for care worker. It also provides Interview KOBOT, which handles accepting applications, and setting interview dates and times on behalf of the hiring manager; Personnel Administration KOBOT, a digital labor force that automates routine task; Corporate Recruiting Page KOBOT, a staff recruitment page for each client; HR KOBOT for Application Support; HR KOBOT which provides application support; Patronage KOBOT, a digital membership card service to attract regular customers with LINE Mini Apps; MEO KOBOT, a service to rank higher in map searches and boost customer acquisition; Baitoru magazine, an information platform that for finding part-time jobs and changing careers; Hatarako magazine, an information source for finding new working styles; AINOW, an AI-specialized media; dip Research Institute; and dip people. DIP Corporation was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

SBS Holdings, Inc. provides logistics services in Japan and internationally. It engages in logistics businesses, including the development of logistic solution services, 3PL global logistics, and in-house delivery of medical supplies, office equipment, furniture, and daily necessities. It also provides import/export and international logistics services, including customs clearance and forwarding, system design and development for warehouse and transportation operations, and marine container offerings. In addition, It operates logistics centers, provides truck transportation services, and offers three temperature zone food logistics services, freight forwarding services, warehousing services, tire and rubber product processing services, same-day delivery services, light cargo vehicle and general cargo transportation services, individual delivery services, and transportation, storage, loading, unloading, and packaging of bearings, automotive-related products, and precision machinery products. Further, it handles the transportation and delivery of electronic parts, automobile parts, and wires, as well as distribution processing. Additionally, it engages in logistics support businesses, such as waste treatment services, store acrylic fixture logistics, manufacturing services, packaging services, drum services, staffing, employment placement, warehouse and factory work contracting services, vehicle leasing, and the sale of fuel, tires, and insurance. It provides direct marketing planning, design, and operation, mail order services, and the leasing and sales of civil engineering and construction-related steel materials. Additionally, it develops logistics facilities, offers rental business and offers driving lessons. The company was formerly known as SBS Co., Ltd. and changed its name to SBS Holdings, Inc. in April 2006. It was incorporated in 1987 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.

Soiken Holdings Inc. engages in the development of biomarkers in Japan. It is involved in the development and sale of cosmetics and dietary supplements comprising imidapeptides; licensing and development of biomarker technology; provision of marketing research and post-marketing surveys for dietary supplements; and research, development, and sale of functional materials, such as lactoferrin, as well as pharmaceutical products from ascochlorin derivatives. The company also provides clinical evaluation tests for foodstuffs using biomarker technology; support for pharmaceutical clinical research and epidemiology studies; and services to health insurance societies, including contracted health guidance, specific health checkup promotion services for the dependents of insured, and service to prevent diabetes. Soiken Holdings Inc. was incorporated in 1994 and is headquartered in Toyonaka, Japan.

Wedge Holdings CO.,LTD., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the finance and content businesses in Japan and South-East Asia. The company offers financing services for the purchase of motorcycles. It also engages in the publication editing activities; planning and development of card games; created and published many games, books and comics; and production and distribution of company owned contents and music labels. The company was incorporated in 2001 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan. Wedge Holdings CO.,LTD. operates as a subsidiary of Showa Holdings Co., Ltd.

Planet, Inc. engages in the standardization of data interchange among companies in Japan. It offers electronic data interchange (EDI) for enterprise systems and procurement; web-EDI; MITEOS, etc. The company also supports and manages data, such as codes and contact information about retailers/wholesalers, product information of CPG, and package inserts and instructions for OTC medicines, as well as offers a service that streamlines the work involved in product master registration. In addition, it provides Buyers' Net, an information provision service that enables the perusal of data, such as product information, industry news, and the campaigns of various companies. Planet, Inc. was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Nippon Care Supply Co., Ltd. engages in the rental and wholesale of welfare equipment businesses in Japan. The company rents or sells welfare equipment, including electric beds, wheelchairs, and bathing aids. The company also offers rehabilitation, life support goods, day care, and diaper delivery services, as well as meal services for nursing care providers. Nippon Care Supply Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Minato, Japan.

Shin Nippon Biomedical Laboratories, Ltd., a contract research organization, engages in the pharmaceutical development, transactional research, and medipolis businesses in Japan and internationally. It offers non-clinical testing and non-clinical regulatory consulting for the development of pharmaceuticals, medical devices, or regenerative medicine products, including safety and pharmacology testing, and pharmacokinetic studies. The company also engages in licensing activities for proprietary products which utilize unique intranasal formulation delivery technology, discovery of future seeds, and business promotion activities; and development of artificial seed production for Japanese eels. In addition, it operates hotels accommodations facilities under the Villa Amafuru Oka and HOTEL Freesia names; and develops and operates geothermal and hot spring thermal power plants. Shin Nippon Biomedical Laboratories, Ltd. was founded in 1957 and is headquartered in Kagoshima, Japan.

Tetsujin Holdings, Inc. engages karaoke, media, alliance, restaurant, beauty, and other businesses in Japan. It offers karaoke distribution systems; mobile content, such as ringtones, ring melodies, lyrics, and deco-mail; operates an android dictionary, a curation site that features articles for Android users; and content collaboration and in-store media products. The company also operates restaurants; nail, eyelash extension, eyebrow, and head spa salons; and manages and operates real estate facilities. The company was formerly known as TETSUJIN Inc. and changed its name to TETSUJIN Holdings, Inc. in February 2024. TETSUJIN Holdings, Inc. was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

KG Intelligence CO., LTD. operates as a content provider company. The company offers Wagasha de DOMO! x Alpa Connect, a tool that manage and operate all postings on eAlpa and other aggregate sites all at once; ARPA LINK, a spot work matching app to pinpoint job openings based on time, location, and skills; e-Arra, a recruitment site that provides information on part-time, full-time, and temporary employment; ALPA, a free job information magazine; and ARPA presents the Suitable Job Fair, an introduction site for the suitable job fair. It also provides career counseling, employment support, and job change support services, as well as foreign care human resource development program; Home Building School, a free consultation support service for home building; Rental Style, a website that provides information on rental apartments, condominiums, and detached houses; Rental Style Column; Mom Rental, a website to search for rental properties near elementary and junior high school districts; Kodate Rental, a website that collects and publishes detached houses and rental homes; Kodate Rental Column; Hospita Renta, a website to search for rental properties near hospitals and medical institutions; Hospita Rental Column; Gakuheya Rental; Gakuhair Rental Column; Chukodate!, a website to search for information on purchasing vacant houses, used homes, detached houses, and single-family; Chukoma!; Kaitochi!; IETO; Mom's House Building; Sumai Satei, a real estate sales website for women; and Rental Style Moving Estimates. In addition, the company offers information magazines; Mama Sore, a website that provides news and columns for mothers raising children; human resource development support, competitor store research, human resource recruitment support, and website creation support services; and printing and binding services, including posters, flyers, pamphlets, and free papers. KG Intelligence CO., LTD. was incorporated in 1950 and is headquartered in Okayama, Japan.

Gendai Agency Inc. engages in planning and production of advertising and promotion services in Japan. The company is involved in planning and production of advertisements using internet media and mass media, such as television, radio, newspapers, and magazines; newspaper insert advertising planning and production; planning and production of direct mail, posters and POP displays for store interior and exterior decoration, and novelty items. It also engages in video, design, and other production services; advertisement planning and media slot sales; planning and production of ads, etc.; operation of customer referral support media; leasing of real estate and office brokerage; and research and development for new service and new business model activities, as well as planning and running of store events. The company was founded in 1994 and is headquartered in Shinjuku, Japan.

M3, Inc. provides medical-related services to physicians and other healthcare professionals through the internet. It operates m3.com, a members-only website for providing information, tools, and services for medical professionals; MR-kun which delivers the latest medical information for daily medical practice; QOL-kun, a marketing support service that provides selected information useful for doctors; m3.com CAREER, a physician recruitment and career change support site; and Yakucari, a job search website for pharmacists. The company also provides online lectures; clinical trial; research targeting domestic medical professionals; medical-related self-planned data and research reports; global health professional research; survey panel provision services; and m3.com opening and management services. In addition, it offers AskDoctors, where registered doctors answer questions about health and illness from the public; MDLinx for medical professionals in the United States; and Doctors.net.uk, a website that provides services for pharmaceutical companies; and drug information database. Further, the company is involved in the sales activities and marketing operations for pharmaceuticals and medical devices; development, sale, and support business of electronic medical records and medical equipment for medical institutions; Support for recruiting subjects necessary for clinical development and clinical research, and related tasks; provision of management support to medical institutions, as well as visiting nursing, day care, and home care support services; and operates podiatry and venous disease clinics, and hospice facilities. Additionally, it offers clinical and medico-political news and education for medical professionals. The company was formerly known as So-netM3, Inc. and changed its name to M3, Inc. in January 2010. M3, Inc. was incorporated in 2000 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Human Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in the human resource, education, nursing care, and other businesses in Japan and internationally. It operates through Manpower Dispatching, DX solution business, and Business Consignment segments. It offers various human resource services, such as temporary staffing, recruitment, business outsourcing, digital transformation, job change and recruitment information services using internet, RPA introduction support, outsourcing, and software development services. The company also provides education services, including adult education, full-time education, child education, international education, translation and training, childcare; nursing care services, such as day care service, home nursing care support, visiting nursing care services, group homes, small-scale multi-functional home care, and nursing home for the elders services. In addition, it manages a professional basketball club operation Osaka Evessa, as well as manages professional e-sports team Human Academy CREST GAMING; and operates a nail salon and franchise stores; plans, develops and sales beauty products; and provides IT solutions, including implementation support and consulting, sales, website production, planning and development of digital content, and marketing DX Support. Human Holdings Co., Ltd. was founded in 1985 and is based in Shinjuku, Japan.

TSUKADA GLOBAL HOLDINGS Inc., through its subsidiaries, engages in the planning, development, and ownership of guest houses, hotels, and restaurants in Japan and internationally. It operates through three segments: Wedding Business, Hotel Business, and Wellness and Relaxation Business. The company plans, operates, and provides wedding, banquet, and accommodation services, as well as guest house, hotel, resort, photo and outsourced wedding services; and operates The Strings Hotel Nagoya and Kimpton Shinjuku Tokyo hotel brands. It also manages and operates hotels and restaurants under the Hotel InterContinental Tokyo Bay, The Strings Hotel Tokyo InterContinental, and The Strings Hotel Tokyo Bay names; operates reflexology salon under the Queensway name; hot spring facility under Miraku Onsen SPA-HERBS name; and fitness club under the BEST STYLE name, as well as a body care salon under the GINZA BODY CARE name. In addition, the company provides food and beverage and services for wedding receptions, wedding costumes and beauty services, such as hair and make-up and bridal beauty care, wedding planning, photography and videography, flower arrangements, MCs, sound systems, and other services; and operates local wedding venues in Hawaii, USA, and Bali, as well as conducts wedding ceremonies and receptions. Further, the company engages in weddings planning, hotel management and outsourcing, and consulting services. The company was formerly known as Best Bridal Inc. and changed its name to TSUKADA GLOBAL HOLDINGS Inc. in July 2014. TSUKADA GLOBAL HOLDINGS Inc. was incorporated in 1995 and is based in Minato, Japan.

ROXX,inc. operates a recruiting platform for hiring entry-level full-time positions in Japan. It offers Z Career, a job-hunting platform optimized for non-desk workers, which is used by jobseekers seeking full-time employment and companies in the manufacturing, construction, transportation, and service industries. The company was incorporated in 2013 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Care Service Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, provides in-home care support and day services in Japan and internationally. The company provides visiting bath, home visit care, home visit nursing care, clean, facility for the elderly, and angel care services, as well as small-scale and multifunctional in-home care services. The company also engages in the rental and sale of assistive equipment. In addition, it provides senior placement services that offers consultation service and senior life total support. The company was founded in 1970 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

Wellnet Corporation develops payment settlement, electronic billing, electronic payment, and mobile authentication services in Japan. The company provides membership management services; multipayment and money transfer services; Shimaeru, a service for concerns about electronic invoices and the electronic bookkeeping act; and Payment Secretary, a smartphone app for making payments directly from bank account. In addition, it offers Bus Mori!, an app to purchase tickets and coupons; Bus Mori! MONTA, a real-time seat reservation management system for bus operators; Bus Mori! Web Ticket Collection Site, a website for receiving bus tickets; and Altair Triple Star Cloud, a MaaS-type sales core system. Wellnet Corporation was incorporated in 1983 and is headquartered in Sapporo, Japan.

World Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in human resources and education, information and telecommunications, real estate, and agricultural park businesses in Japan. The company offers subcontracting, business process outsourcing, temporary staffing services, research and development, manufacturing, electromechanical design development, information technology system design development, and medical and biotechnology research and development services. It is also involved in the planning, development, and sale of condominiums; renovation of condominiums and detached houses; rental property brokerage and real estate brokerage businesses; development, manufacturing, sale, and rental of prefabricated houses; real estate fund management; and the management and collection of receivables. In addition, the company engages in the operation of mobile phone stores and call centers; management of agricultural parks; electronics manufacturing services; power supply businesses; and electronic device repair services. The company was formerly known as WORLD INTEC Co., Ltd. The company was incorporated in 1993 and is headquartered in Fukuoka City, Japan.

DeNA Co., Ltd. develops and operates various mobile and online services in Japan and internationally. It operates DeNA games, a free-to-play mobile apps and browser games; Mobage, an entertainment platform; Yahoo! Mobage, which offers social games for PC browsers; AndApp, a platform that allows users to play mobile game apps on PC browsers under the same user account; Pococha, a social live streaming community; and IRIAM, an app where users can live stream as an anime characters. The company also operates kencom, which supports health insurance societies to manage their members' health data; and ONSEI, an AI-driven cognitive self-check app. In addition, it operates MENKYO, which enables cognitive function test for elderly drivers seeking license renewal; MOGI, a cognitive function test similar to MENKYO; SHINRI-ADAS, a cognitive functional test; Join, a communication app; MySOS, a life-saving and health support app with health and medical record for the user and their family; Team, a solution that connects medical and healthcare services and supports multi-professional collaboration; Join Mobile Clinic, an integrated telemedicine support solution that combines portable medical devices and Join; and Tsunaken, a health checkup online digital transformation solution. Further, the company operates DENA SPORTS GROUP, Yokohama DeNA Baystars, Kawasaki Brave Thunders, S.C.SAGAMIHARA, Virtual KEIBI System, DeNA AI, Strategic Investment Office, and Delight Ventures. DeNA Co., Ltd. was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in Shibuya, Japan.

Hakuhodo DY Holdings Inc. engages in the advertising and marketing services in Japan and internationally. It offers support in the area of digital marketing, software, media production and operation, and digital transformation. The company also provides brand building services. In addition, it specializes in business development in the entertainment field, including animated programs and live events. The company was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.

CEDAR.Co.,Ltd. provides nursing care and rehabilitation services in Japan. It offers day care, resident life care, home-visit nursing care, home help, home care support, group home, and short-term residency care services. CEDAR.Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1981 and is based in Kitakyushu, Japan.

Kyodo Public Relations Co., Ltd. operates as an integrated communications and public relations agency in Japan and internationally. The company offers media relations, strategy, public relations consulting, crisis and risk management, public affairs, online and offline seminars, public relation training and seminar, and digital marketing services. It also engages in influencer marketing and AI/big data solution business. The company was incorporated in 1964 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.

Shinwa Wise Holdings Co.,Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, operates as an auction company focusing on fine arts in Japan. The company engages in an art dealing and gallery management business; asset protection of diamonds; and cultural support projects. It is also involved in the solar power generation facilities business. The company was formerly known as Shinwa Art Auction Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Shinwa Wise Holdings Co.,Ltd. in December 2017. Shinwa Wise Holdings Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Chiyoda, Japan.

Asukanet Co., Ltd. engages in photo book businesses in Japan. It creates and sells the funeral, photo book, and aerial display businesses that support small lots from one book by on-demand printing, as well as develops related software; produces funeral photographs for funeral companies and homes; and provides aerial display related services. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is headquartered in Hiroshima, Japan.

Gurunavi, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the provision of restaurant information to consumers via personal computers and smartphones in Japan. The company provides restaurant information and online reservation services through the restaurant search site Rakuten Gurunavi. It also offers internet-based PR and marketing support services; as well as administrative, and employee welfare services. In addition, the company provides food-related research and information services; and management, planning, operation, and administration of restaurants. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
